name: Lotus Shape Jewelry Dish
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality glazed ceramic, offering a smooth, sturdy, and elegant finish for everyday decorative use.
    - Designed in a graceful lotus leaf shape, creating a soft and artistic look that adds charm to any space.
    - The glazed ceramic surface gives the dish a refined appearance while helping it feel durable and substantial.
    - Each piece is formed through a special firing process, so the glaze may naturally vary slightly in shade, giving every dish a unique look.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 2 style options:
              +) Small Wave: 9.7 x 11 x  2.5 cm ~ 3.82 x 4.33 x 0.98 in
              +) Large Wave: 11.3 x 2.41 ~ 4.45 x 0.95 in
    📌 Note:  The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customize the printed design only.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses UV DTF printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and a durable decorative finish.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a jewelry dish and a decorative ceramic accent.
    - Designed for storing rings, earrings, bracelets, necklaces, hair clips, keys, and other small everyday items.
    - Suitable for vanities, dressers, bedside tables, bathrooms, office desks, and decorative shelf styling.
    - The lotus leaf design helps create a soft and elegant display while keeping small items organized.
    - Perfect for everyday jewelry storage or as a small decorative catchall tray.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and elegant gift for moms, wives, girlfriends, sisters, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, Mother’s Day, anniversaries, holidays, bridal gifts, thank-you gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves floral-inspired décor, ceramic keepsakes, and delicate home accessories.
    - Great for vanity décor, jewelry organization, and small decorative displays.
    - A charming gift that combines beauty, usefulness, and handcrafted appeal.
    - Adds a soft, graceful, and memorable touch to any space 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Lotus Shape Jewelry Dish

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
